gui.sandstorm.datapad.chapter.1: CHAPTER I: CRASH LANDING & INITIAL ADAPTATION
gui.sandstorm.datapad.chapter.2: CHAPTER II: UNDERGROUND AQUIFERS & SILICON METALLURGY
gui.sandstorm.datapad.chapter.4: CHAPTER IV: SEISMIC DEFENSE & HEAVY MECHANIZATION

quest.sandstorm.suit_diagnostics.title: Suit Systems Diagnostics
quest.sandstorm.suit_diagnostics.task: Reach 60% battery on your space suit.
quest.sandstorm.suit_diagnostics.note: I.A.T.I.: Expose your suit to direct sunlight in the desert to recharge energy cells. Once it reaches 60%, this directive will be fulfilled.
quest.sandstorm.compact_sandstone.title: Dune Engineering: Sandstone
quest.sandstorm.compact_sandstone.task: Collect sand blocks from the entry ramp and compact 4 sand into Sandstone.
quest.sandstorm.compact_sandstone.note: I.A.T.I.: Sandstone serves as primary structural material in the absence of wood.
quest.sandstorm.emergency_workbench.task: Access the cabin workbench or assemble a new one using 4 Sandstone blocks.
quest.sandstorm.emergency_workbench.note: I.A.T.I.: Enables crafting structural rods and advanced 3x3 machinery.
quest.sandstorm.sandstone_furnace.title: Thermal Sandstone Furnace
quest.sandstorm.sandstone_furnace.task: Build a furnace using 8 Sandstone blocks at the workbench.
quest.sandstorm.sandstone_furnace.note: I.A.T.I.: Vital for glass smelting, silicon processing, and water purification.
quest.sandstorm.glass_canister.title: Glass Canisters
quest.sandstorm.glass_canister.task: Smelt sand in the furnace to produce glass and craft containment bottles.
quest.sandstorm.glass_canister.note: I.A.T.I.: Glass withstands high mineral acidity in subterranean brine.
quest.sandstorm.brackish_brine.title: Brackish Water Extraction
quest.sandstorm.brackish_brine.task: Dig below Y=60 to locate the aquifer and fill your glass bottles.
quest.sandstorm.brackish_brine.note: I.A.T.I.: Underground water contains lethal salt levels. Purify before consumption.
quest.sandstorm.thermal_purification.tas: Boil brackish water in the furnace to yield drinkable water and mineral salt.
quest.sandstorm.thermal_purification.not: I.A.T.I.: Restores vital hydration and prevents catastrophic biostatic failure.
quest.sandstorm.silicon_smelting.title: Raw Silicon Smelting
quest.sandstorm.silicon_smelting.task: Subject desert sand to extreme heat in the furnace to extract Raw Silicon.
quest.sandstorm.silicon_smelting.note: I.A.T.I.: Foundation component for logic boards and navigation sensors.
quest.sandstorm.silicon_wafer.title: Silicon Wafer Lamination
quest.sandstorm.silicon_wafer.task: Refine raw silicon in the furnace to forge ultra-pure silicon wafers.
quest.sandstorm.silicon_wafer.note: I.A.T.I.: Wafers serve as micro-substrates for computational conductors.
quest.sandstorm.circuit_manufacturing.ta: Combine silicon wafers, raw silicon, and copper to manufacture circuits.
quest.sandstorm.circuit_manufacturing.no: I.A.T.I.: Copper wiring and scrap metals can be reclaimed from Buried Tech Ruins.
quest.sandstorm.desalination_system.task: Build the Desalination Filter block for automated water production.
quest.sandstorm.desalination_system.note: I.A.T.I.: Eliminates furnace fuel consumption for water supply.
quest.sandstorm.additive_printer.title: 3D Lithographic Printer
quest.sandstorm.additive_printer.task: Assemble the 3D Printer to manufacture high-precision mechatronic components.
quest.sandstorm.additive_printer.note: I.A.T.I.: Fabricates advanced mechanisms that cannot be crafted manually.
Construct and install the Wireless Solar Receiver on the ship hull to recharge suits remotely.
I.A.T.I.: Converts solar radiation into high-efficiency microwave beams, powering suits wirelessly.
quest.sandstorm.anomaly_sensor.title: Subsurface Radar Scanner
quest.sandstorm.anomaly_sensor.task: Craft the Anomaly Radar to detect buried ruins and seismic hazards.
quest.sandstorm.anomaly_sensor.note: I.A.T.I.: Provides early warnings for apex sandworms and highlights salvage points.
quest.sandstorm.seismic_thumper.title: Ground Seismic Thumper
quest.sandstorm.seismic_thumper.task: Craft and deploy the Thumper on sand to project rhythmic acoustic pulses.
quest.sandstorm.seismic_thumper.note: I.A.T.I.: Rhythmic thumping attracts apex sandworms away from your base.
quest.sandstorm.seismic_bait.title: Active Seismic Bait
quest.sandstorm.seismic_bait.task: Activate the Thumper in the open desert to emit seismic shockwaves.
quest.sandstorm.seismic_bait.note: I.A.T.I.: Sustained 25.0 pulses will draw any subterranean apex predator in the sector.
quest.sandstorm.sandworm_hunt.title: Desert Apex Predator
quest.sandstorm.sandworm_hunt.task: Engage and slay a giant Sandworm in the open desert dunes.
quest.sandstorm.sandworm_hunt.note: I.A.T.I.: The titan is vulnerable to heavy ordnance when breaching the surface to strike.
quest.sandstorm.sandworm_harvest.title: Chitin Spoils
quest.sandstorm.sandworm_harvest.task: Harvest Sandworm Chitin from the remains of a defeated worm.
quest.sandstorm.sandworm_harvest.note: I.A.T.I.: The outer carapace withstands extreme friction and serves as superior industrial plating.
quest.sandstorm.sonic_defense.title: Acoustic Dispersion Weapon
quest.sandstorm.sonic_defense.task: Assemble the Sonic Cannon shockwave projector for hostile defense.
quest.sandstorm.sonic_defense.note: I.A.T.I.: Discharges shock pulses that repel and disorient planetary fauna.
quest.sandstorm.nanite_assembler.title: Molecular Nanite Fabricator
quest.sandstorm.nanite_assembler.task: Construct the Nanite Fabricator to synthesize actuators and re-engineer matter.
quest.sandstorm.nanite_assembler.note: I.A.T.I.: Synthesizes top-tier components and duplicates the Datapad.
quest.sandstorm.mecha_assembly.title: Industrial Assembly Bay & Robotics
quest.sandstorm.mecha_assembly.task: Deploy the Assembly Bay and Drone Dock to manufacture heavy vehicles.
quest.sandstorm.mecha_assembly.note: I.A.T.I.: Excavator vehicles mine deep hardstone that hand tools cannot breach.
quest.sandstorm.atmospheric_probe.title: Atmospheric Biospheric Probe
quest.sandstorm.atmospheric_probe.task: Craft the Atmospheric Analyzer and survey the planetary aridity index.
quest.sandstorm.atmospheric_probe.note: I.A.T.I.: Calculates aerosol dissipation rates required for terraforming.
quest.sandstorm.nutrient_bomb.title: Nutrient Dispersion Bomb
quest.sandstorm.nutrient_bomb.task: Synthesize the Nutrient Bomb and throw it onto barren sand to begin soil bioremediation.
quest.sandstorm.nutrient_bomb.note: I.A.T.I.: Disperses biochemical catalysts that enrich silicates, turning sand into fertile soil and grass.
quest.sandstorm.planet_terraformer.title: Planetary Atmosphere Processor
quest.sandstorm.planet_terraformer.task: Build and power the Atmospheric Terraformer to deploy a climate shield dome.
quest.sandstorm.planet_terraformer.note: I.A.T.I.: Creates a protected biosphere immune to extreme heat and sandstorms.
quest.sandstorm.planetary_genesis.title: The New Genesis: Restored Biosphere
quest.sandstorm.planetary_genesis.task: Expand the terraforming field until barren sand transforms into lush grass and flora.
quest.sandstorm.planetary_genesis.note: I.A.T.I.: Mission accomplished. The hostile desert blooms into humanity's new home.
